page.overview:
Who is Cyrano?

Cyrano is a middle-aged man with dark skin, grey hair, green eyes, a mustache, and a soul patch. He wears a white fedora with a blue brim, a matching coat, both white shirt and trousers, a black and blue scarf, red tie and a black vest and matching shoes, with no socks underneath. He wears a silver wedding ring on his left ring finger.

Cyrano is said to be rather forgetful due to his age, often resulting in Briar and Lacey completing tasks in his place.

Cyrano is the founder and director of the Blueberry Academy in Unova. He befriended Clavell when they were young, and he was the one who suggested that he wear Premier Balls around his waist despite not using them.

After learning of the player through the joint field trip with Carmine and Kieran, Cyrano decides to invite the player to his academy as an exchange student.
